hypothesis: After the #8255 per-text LockMask query and before its first XTEST request, a separate XKB client can set Caps Lock and make the first requested lowercase character arrive uppercase while dispatch reports completed.

environment.type: dedicated isolated OrbStack Ubuntu Noble ARM64 VM with private TCP-disabled Xvfb
environment.host_or_peer_network_route: none inside the per-run network namespace; VM setup networking is separate
environment.network_during_cases: disabled by per-run network namespace with no non-loopback route or up interface; acquire packages and sources before allocation
environment.expected_xvfb_stderr_scope: Ubuntu Noble Xvfb emits the captured nonfatal xkbcomp unresolved-XF86-keysym warning block; exact bytes are retained per server and hash-checked

per_case_evidence: exact program and response; dispatch completion
private Xvfb display and independent before/after LockMask and 32-byte keymap snapshots
Tk Entry event and exact final value
separate actor IPC request, verified pre/post lock state, mutation sync and ACK monotonic timestamps for interposed arm
all process argv, PIDs, exits, stderr, and cleanup state
runtime imported source paths and SHA-256 values

decision.pass: All 9 cases match the frozen arm outcomes; every dispatch reports completed; the interposed actor verifies OFF->ON and ACK precedes first KeyPress; each Xvfb starts fresh; keymaps are all released; process/error/source audits pass; all effective corruption controls reject.
decision.fail: A complete, unambiguous case contradicts its frozen expected outcome or the candidate does not exhibit the interposed first-character change.
decision.stop_hold: Any missing identity, ordering, event/value, process, cleanup, environment, or audit evidence; infrastructure failure; or first unexpected/ambiguous case. No replacement or retry.

mutation_controls: actor ACK not before first KeyPress
scope_limits: one VM, Xvfb/Tk Entry, XKB map, and source closure only
deterministic injected interposition; no natural occurrence-rate estimate
no live desktop, other GUI applications/layouts, IME, physical HID, model utility, latency, prevention, recovery correctness, production safety, or product claim
does not adjudicate open PR #8308; tested arms hold no modifiers or nonmodifier keys, so that PR's held-key semantics remain out of scope
